en.cloud: Audio will be sent to the selected cloud service.
en.conflict: Your draft changed. The transcript is preserved and can be inserted at the current cursor.
en.deviceMissing: Microphone unavailable. Choose another input device.
en.download.dns: Cannot download {resource}: the download address could not be resolved.
en.download.http: Cannot download {resource}: the download service returned HTTP {status}.
en.download.integrity: The download of {resource} is incomplete or failed verification.
en.download.network: Cannot download {resource}: connection to the download service failed.
en.download.storage: Cannot save {resource}: insufficient disk space or write permission.
en.downloadAdvice.certificate: Check the system clock, trusted certificates and proxy settings on the machine running DSH, then retry.
en.downloadAdvice.dns: Check DNS and proxy settings on the machine running DSH. Confirm that it can resolve the download source domain, then retry.
en.downloadAdvice.http: Confirm that the download address is available and the proxy can reach the download service, or retry later.
en.downloadAdvice.integrity: Retry the download. Other completed and verified files are retained.
en.downloadAdvice.network: Check that the machine running DSH can reach the download source and its model download services. Configure a proxy on that machine if needed, then retry.
en.downloadAdvice.storage: Check available disk space and write permission for the model directory on the machine running DSH, then retry.
en.downloadAdvice.timeout: Check the network or proxy connection on the machine running DSH, then retry later. Verified downloaded files are retained.
en.downloadAdvice.unknown: Check the network, disk space and model directory permissions on the machine running DSH, then retry.
en.interrupted: Recording was interrupted. Please try again.
en.local: Audio is recognized on the machine running DSH. If models need downloading, that machine must be able to reach the selected source and its file services. Configure a proxy on that machine if needed.
en.permission: Microphone access is disabled. Allow it in browser and system settings.
en.preparation.cancelled: Preparation cancelled. Completed downloads are retained.
en.preparation.standby: Local resources are prepared. Recording wakes the recognizer.
en.preparation.unprepared: First use downloads the local recognition models.
en.setup.diskValue: Allow about {gb} GB for models, runtime, and download caches
en.setup.estimateNote: These are estimates; slow networks may take longer. Downloads are reused; idle models release memory by default.
en.setup.local: Local models will be downloaded to the machine running DSH. No Python or compiler is required.
en.setup.memoryValue: About {gb} GB with the model loaded; recognition may use more
en.setup.timeValue: Allow roughly {min}–{max} minutes, depending on the network and machine
en.setupPrompt.body: Voice input is enabled. First use requires downloading and preparing local recognition models. Open the plugin details to review disk space, memory and time estimates before starting setup.
en.setupPrompt.title: Set up voice input before recording
en.setupPrompt.unavailableBody: Open the voice plugin details to check recognition status, preparation progress, or errors.
en.sourceAutoHelp: Prefer the first responding source and try another if a download fails.
en.sourceManualHelp: Download only from the selected source. Verified downloaded files are reused.
en.tooLarge: The recording exceeds the service limit. Try a shorter recording.
en.unavailable: This browser cannot record audio. Use a browser with microphone support.

zh.cloud: 音频将发送至所选云端服务。
zh.conflict: 草稿已被修改。识别文字已保留，可在当前光标位置插入。
zh.deviceMissing: 麦克风不可用，请选择其他输入设备
zh.download.certificate: 无法下载 {resource}：安全连接的证书校验失败。
zh.download.dns: 无法下载 {resource}：无法解析下载地址。
zh.download.http: 无法下载 {resource}：下载服务返回 HTTP {status}。
zh.download.integrity: {resource} 下载不完整或文件校验失败。
zh.download.network: 无法下载 {resource}：连接下载服务失败。
zh.download.storage: 无法保存 {resource}：磁盘空间不足或没有写入权限。
zh.downloadAdvice.certificate: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的系统时间、受信任证书和代理设置后重试。
zh.downloadAdvice.dns: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的 DNS 和代理设置，确认可以解析下载来源的域名后重试。
zh.downloadAdvice.http: 请确认下载地址可用、代理可正常连接下载服务，或稍后重试。
zh.downloadAdvice.integrity: 请重试下载。已完成并通过校验的其他文件会保留。
zh.downloadAdvice.network: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器能否访问下载来源及其模型下载服务；如需代理，请在该机器上配置后重试。
zh.downloadAdvice.storage: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的剩余磁盘空间，以及模型目录的写入权限后重试。
zh.downloadAdvice.timeout: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的网络或代理连接，稍后重试。已下载并通过校验的文件会保留。
zh.downloadAdvice.unknown: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的网络、磁盘空间和模型目录权限后重试。
zh.local: 音频在运行 DSH 的机器上识别。需要下载模型时，请确保该机器能访问所选下载源及其文件服务。如需代理，请在该机器上配置。
zh.permission: 麦克风权限未开启，请在浏览器和系统设置中允许访问。
zh.preparation.cancelled: 准备已取消，已完成的下载会保留。
zh.preparation.standby: 本地资源已准备，录音时自动唤醒。
zh.preparation.unprepared: 首次使用需要下载本地识别模型。
zh.setup.diskValue: 建议预留约 {gb} GB，包含模型、运行时和下载缓存
zh.setup.estimateNote: 以上为估算；网络较慢时可能更久。已下载的资源会复用，默认在闲置后释放模型内存。
zh.setup.local: 将在运行 DSH 的机器上下载本地模型，无需安装 Python 或编译工具。
zh.setup.memoryValue: 模型加载后约 {gb} GB，识别时可能更高
zh.setup.timeValue: 参考 {min}–{max} 分钟，取决于网络和机器性能
zh.setupPrompt.body: 语音输入插件已开启。首次使用需要在本机下载并准备识别模型，请前往插件详情页查看空间、内存和时间说明，再开始安装。
zh.setupPrompt.title: 使用语音输入前需要安装
zh.setupPrompt.unavailableBody: 请前往语音插件详情页查看识别服务状态、准备进度或错误信息
zh.sourceAutoHelp: 优先使用响应较快的源，下载失败时自动尝试其他源。
zh.sourceManualHelp: 仅从所选源下载；已下载并通过校验的文件会复用。
zh.tooLarge: 录音超过服务限制，请缩短录音后重试。
zh.unavailable: 当前浏览器不支持录音，请使用支持麦克风的浏览器。
